opening.argument: The presentation promotes participation through member success stories, extraordinary reported returns, recurring earnings, and a direct invitation to join. One speaker says, “I started 137 days ago with only $25,610. And right now I am reaching $140,000 dollars,” then claims, “I am actually earning around $1400 on an everyday basis seven days a week.” Another presents a $20,000 bank-loan amount as producing $20,000 per day and calls it “the power of BCC,” while listeners are told, “So, join with BitConnect. Stay connected. Just enjoy life.” The performance reinforces the same investment proposition by linking staking and lending with making a fortune and receiving interest. The presentation also claims BCC or Bitcoin can be transferred into USD, British Pound, or Euro. Although it mentions people calling the activity a scam and warning of losses, that skepticism is presented within the event and rejected, while the exact terms and accuracy of the financial claims remain unverified.
